line.comment: * Mordan4. - Fixed to handle systems located more than 1 jump apart.
* Add-Ons 2.0: Give some flavor to these positions.
* Creating wormholes. Cannot be in the same sector.
* Use free gate IDs, i.e. IDs not used for other gates. -1, 0, 1, 2, 3 are reserved.
* Abort if warpgates with these IDs aready exist

line.comment: * Add-Ons 2.0: If we're making a wormhole, then we need to obtain a random coordinate from the source: at least ~10km from Outpost.
* Gate ID 25 corresponds to a new gate entry in TGates. The other gate IDs are reserved, so best to create a new one.
* posx and posz already calculated earlier. y-coordinate is now randomized between +/- 6km.
* Show an animation when the gate appears.
* Source is facing south, so assign destination to face north side.
* Source is facing north, so assign destination to face south side.
* Source is facing west, so assign destination to face east side.
* Source is facing east, so assign destination to face west side.
